rationale: The explanation now rests on a source-level claim that the single max promise log merged at the prepare quorum can omit a StopSign carried by a losing promise. That claim makes a concrete, observable prediction: among the Promises delivered to node 4, at least one carrying a StopSign in its log_sync has a lower accept round than a Promise without the StopSign that was delivered earlier, and node 4's own accepted index never reaches the StopSign while it still decides higher indexes. This revision keeps the seeded run, trace, fields and comparison unchanged and records every Promise delivered to node 4 with its accept round, accepted index, decided index and whether its log_sync carries a StopSign, plus node 4's accepted-index transitions during the run.

experiment.revision_reason: Adds diagnostics for the promise-merge explanation: up to forty Promises delivered to node 4 are recorded with sender, accept round, accept round of the last accepted entry, accepted index, decided index and whether the log_sync carries a StopSign, together with up to twenty accepted-index transitions on node 4 and its final accepted/decided indices. The seeded schedule, node 3 trace and comparison are unchanged.

scope.description: Same five-node lossy stress with seed 0xbe5466cf34e90c6c, reconfigure at action 450 and 20 percent loss, run id 13, with the 150-round fair-delivery convergence and node 3 trace unchanged. During the 900 randomized actions every successfully delivered Promise addressed to pid 4 is recorded with sender, ballot number, the accept round of its last accepted entry, accepted index, decided index and whether its log_sync carries a StopSign; node 4's accepted index is sampled after every action and its transitions are recorded.
assumptions: The 900-action schedule is deterministic for the fixed seed, so the previously observed node 3 stall is expected to recur.
A Promise's log_sync stopsign flag reflects the StopSign the follower would contribute at quorum formation.
Dropped Promises are not recorded, so the recorded set is a subset of what node 4's leader state may have considered.
excluded: Starting the next configuration, snapshots, flexible quorums, crash-restart and Byzantine participants.

experiment.prefix: Identical to randomized_reconfig_diagnose_lag with run id 13, including the seeded 900-action schedule, the reconfigure at action 450, the 150-round convergence loop, the node 3 ordered trace and every existing field. New in this revision: when a queued message addressed to pid 4 is delivered, a Promise is formatted as step:fromX,nY,naZ,aidxA,didxD,ssS where Y is the promise ballot number, Z the accept round of its last accepted entry, A the accepted index, D the decided index and S is 1 when the promise log_sync carries a StopSign, up to forty entries; node 4's accepted index is compared after every action and up to twenty step:old->new transitions are recorded. The safety event adds p4_accepted, p4_decided, p4_promises and p4_acc_changes.

comparisons.description: Bounded convergence past the resend timeout: all nodes report the same decided index.
